# Glenhold Bookkeeping

Simi Valley-based small business bookkeeping. Work directly with Jack, a former Big 4 accountant and Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor. Glenhold Bookkeeping is the client-facing name of Glenhold Advisory LLC.

Phone: (805) 419-3451
Email: jack@glenhold.com

Monthly plans start at $349 (Essential), $599 (Core), and $1,499 (Strategic). Quotes depend on volume, accounts, and reporting complexity. Cleanup and training are quoted separately. Tax return preparation and filing are separate from the listed bookkeeping plans.

## Questions
### How much does monthly bookkeeping cost?

Monthly plans start at $349 for Essential, $599 for Core, and $1,499 for Strategic. Your quote depends on transaction volume, the number of accounts, and reporting complexity. Cleanup, catch-up, consulting, and training are quoted separately.

### What is included in monthly bookkeeping?

All monthly plans include transaction categorization, bank and credit card reconciliation, a profit and loss statement, and a balance sheet. Core adds a quarterly profit and expense summary, year-to-date comparisons, and priority support. Strategic adds tailored reporting and a monthly call, along with the services listed on the pricing page.

### Do you work with my type of business?

I work with small businesses across industries. Tell me how your business operates and what help you need. The scope is based on your accounts, transactions, and reporting requirements.

### Can you help if my books are behind?

Yes. Cleanup and catch-up can include missing transactions, account reconciliation, chart of accounts cleanup, and financial reports for the periods agreed. The quote and timeline depend on the records available and the work required.

### Can you help me with QuickBooks Online?

Yes. Jack is a Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor and offers QuickBooks Online setup, chart of accounts organization, training, and accuracy check-ins. You can get help with a specific issue or discuss ongoing bookkeeping.

### Who will I work with?

You work directly with me, the founder of Glenhold Bookkeeping, a Simi Valley local and former Big 4 accountant.

### When will I receive my monthly reports?

The target is the 15th of the following month, once the necessary statements and answers are available. I will discuss the monthly schedule and what information is needed from you.

### Can you work with my tax preparer?

Yes. I organize the bookkeeping and prepare financial reports you can share with your CPA or tax preparer. Tax return preparation and filing are separate from the bookkeeping services listed here.

### Where do you provide bookkeeping services?

Glenhold is based in Simi Valley and focuses on surrounding Ventura County and Los Angeles County communities, generally within about an hour depending on traffic. Share your city when you get in touch so I can confirm the fit.

### What do you need to prepare a quote?

Start with the type of business, the number of bank and credit card accounts, whether the books are current, and the help you want. Mention any deadlines. There is no need to send bank statements or sensitive records with your first message.

### What does the first-month guarantee cover?

Love your first month of monthly bookkeeping, or that month is free. Cleanup, catch-up, consulting, and training are scoped separately. Discuss the details with me before work begins.

### How do I get started?

Book a free introductory call or send a message through the website. I will reply within one business day to discuss your needs and the next step.
